newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: News Corp says STAR TV results steady.
newsitem.headline: News Corp says STAR TV results steady.

text.p: Rupert Murdoch's media empire News Corp Ltd said on Thursday results for its Asian satellite television business STAR TV was in line with the prior year.

"While STAR TV continues its extensive efforts to strengthen and expand its position in its major targeted markets, operating results in line with the prior year," News Corp in a statement accompanying its third quarter results.
News Corp did not specify in the results whether it was referring to results for the three months to March 31 or the nine month period to March.

News Corp said STAR has now extended its sports programming in conjunction with ESPN, launched its pay television service in Indonesia and increased its subscription revenues in Taiwan, India and several other markets throughout Southeast Asia.
ESPN is a sports programmer and is 80 percent owned by Walt Disney and 20 percent by Hearst Corp of the United States.

Last year, News Corp said STAR TV losses widened in the March 1996 quarter, but did not give any figures. News Corp has not released STAR TV's 1995/96 year results, but it is estimated to have booked a loss of up to US$80 million.
News Corp earlier reported a 34 percent rise in net profit before abnormals of A$376 million for the three months ended March 31, 1997 on a 23 percent rise in operating revenue to A$3.7 billion.
